leaves.label: Psychological Drama
leaves.defn: A drama whose engine is one person's inner state — grief, breakdown, trauma or obsession — rendered from inside (Three Colors: Blue, Through a Glass Darkly, Manchester by the Sea, Death in Venice). leaves.axis: by the inner condition: grief first, then breakdown and mental illness, trauma and guilt, and obsession last
